ctx: Rik 66.2 Saṃhitā line 2: वा॒जी न प्री॒तो व॑यो दधाति
note: Stroke above vayo: on va (as written) or on yo?

file: > **तं व॑श्च॒राथा॑ व॒यं व॑स॒त्यास्तं॒ न गावो॒ नक्ष॑न्त इ॒द्धम् ।** [accent ?]
note: In vasatyāstaṃ: is the line under the subscript of tyā an anudātta (then tyā॒) or part of the glyph? Line under sta read as anudātta.
svar: stroke above and line below sva — svarita or anudātta? Line under nta/gā: which syllable?
Last two digits: read 53; the first of them looks like ಜ (5?).
Read 4-500: the ಜ-like digit (5?) then two zeros.
Digits after 4-4: read like ಜ (5?) and a 7/2.
